verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a full-featured Test/sandbox environment that replicates production and lets developers simulate authorizations, captures/refunds, and even full dispute lifecycles via API, plus collaborative authorization for approving/declining transactions in real time. However, the pack never explicitly names 'clearing' or 'reversal' simulation as distinct lifecycle events, only broader 'transactions' and 'compliance scenarios.' missing for 10: explicit sandbox support for clearings and reversals, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the full lifecycle simulation.
